faq.q: Can I make Shopify product photos from one photo each?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo per product and pick a square page or collection image. The credit cost shows before each file is made.

faq.q: What image size works for Shopify product pages?
faq.a: A square file around 2048 by 2048 pixels usually displays well, and it also works on a collection card. Check how your storefront shows it.

faq.q: How do I make a whole collection look consistent?
faq.a: Use the same square shape and a related background treatment for every product, then compare each new image beside the others in the collection.

faq.q: Do I need to reshoot older products?
faq.a: No. Start from the photo you already have for each item, so older products can match new arrivals without another shoot.

faq.q: Can I add a short clip to a product page?
faq.a: Yes. Make a clip of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds and add it in Shopify product media. Check your store's current file rules first.

faq.q: Should social clips go in the same product gallery?
faq.a: Keep the square images in the product gallery and make a separate vertical file for Stories or Reels, so the grid stays even.
Use a sharp, well-lit photo that shows the whole product. A clear front or three-quarter view works well.

faq.q: Are the files mine to use on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours to add in Shopify admin, with product name and price set by you.
